question: Can you calculate the 5-day symmetric moving average of predicted toy sales for December 5 to 8, 2018, using daily sales data from January 1, 2017, to August 29, 2018, with a simple linear regression model? Finally provide the sum of those four 5-day moving averages?
sql:
WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE) as sale_date,
        SUM(CAST(order_items.price AS DOUBLE)) as daily_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE)) as day_num
    FROM orders
    JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
    WHERE products.product_category_name = 'brinquedos'
        AND CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE)
),
regression_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM daily_sales
),
extended_predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        667 as day_num,
        slope * 667 + intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM regression_params
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 668, slope * 668 + intercept FROM regression_params
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 669, slope * 669 + intercept FROM regression_params
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 670, slope * 670 + intercept FROM regression_params
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 671, slope * 671 + intercept FROM regression_params
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 672, slope * 672 + intercept FROM regression_params
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 673, slope * 673 + intercept FROM regression_params
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 674, slope * 674 + intercept FROM regression_params
)
SELECT * FROM extended_predictions
ORDER BY day_num

WITH daily_sales AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE) as sale_date,
        SUM(CAST(order_items.price AS DOUBLE)) as daily_sales,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE)) as day_num
    FROM orders
    JOIN order_items ON orders.order_id = order_items.order_id
    JOIN products ON order_items.product_id = products.product_id
    WHERE products.product_category_name = 'brinquedos'
        AND CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE) >= '2017-01-01'
        AND CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE) <= '2018-08-29'
    GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(order_purchase_timestamp, 1, 10) AS DATE)
),
regression_params AS (
    SELECT 
        REGR_SLOPE(daily_sales, day_num) as slope,
        REGR_INTERCEPT(daily_sales, day_num) as intercept
    FROM daily_sales
),
extended_predictions AS (
    SELECT 
        generate_series(667, 674, 1) as day_num
),
predictions_extended AS (
    SELECT 
        e.day_num,
        e.slope * e.day_num + e.intercept as predicted_sales
    FROM extended_predictions e
    CROSS JOIN regression_params r
)
SELECT * FROM predictions_extended
ORDER BY day_num
